acs.text: status/check/admit/tick/prepare/confirm/tasks/verifier/complete/release及旧program路径共用规范化范围和状态迁移规则；单feature兼容，整体必须全部必需任务及集成验证成功并有独立审查与人工批准；不能只放宽prepare旧校验。

verification.spec: go test ./internal/orchestrator ./internal/cli -run TestScopeDelivery -count=1 -v；bash e2e/run_e2e.sh；S6新增真实CLI单feature/多模块成功、拒绝、恢复链路，旧E2E不能代替。
